package.name: bev_range
package.description: Garmin LIDAR-Lite ranger for the J106 rig. The sensor hangs off the camtrig MCU's I2C, not the Tegra's, so every reading arrives stamped with the trigger's own pulse counter — the same counter the cameras' seq advances on, making range-to-frame an exact integer join rather than a clock comparison. Published as sensor_msgs/Range and logged to CSV the same way bev_imu logs imu0.csv.
